the oestrogen-dependent, oestrogen-responsive human breast cancer cell T47D can be rendered ER-negative by long-term growth in an oestrogen-free culture medium.
we have derived a cell line from the T47D human ER-positive breast cancer cell line that is ER-negative, oestrogen-independent and resistant to all tested anti-oestrogens.
